additional_info.subject: 0372766 - ID0372766-DC/Si-D/IL-[Y2 / R2 312900727017] During commission the voltage transducer was faulted TF5 CRM:00472000190
additional_info.body:
Hello Itai,
In our intervention yesterday we identify a faulty Voltage Transducer (TF5). Charger was not able to do the converter grouping, to proceed with the commissioning we have replaced TF5 with TF1. After that we could do the converter grouping and we disabled Outlet1.
The Voltage Transducer in Outlet 1 must be replaced.
